title: PPI v1 record
description: A host record pushed through `ingest`. The provider renders it deterministically into canonical text, so the official facts below (registration number, receipt time, type, unit, due date) can be cited with spans. Records are parents; attachments point to them with `parent_ref`.

registration_number.description: The official number the host gave the record when it was registered.

direction.description: Whether the record came in, went out, or stayed inside the organisation.

document_type.description: Official document type, from the host's `document_types` vocabulary. Null while the record is untyped.

unit.description: Organisational unit currently responsible, from the host's `units` vocabulary.

due_date.description: The host's official due date. The host's value is the official one; a provider that computes a different date sends a `deadline` recommendation instead of overriding it.

status.description: Host-defined status label, for display and for excluding open records from training labels.

channel.description: Host-defined intake channel label (for example counter, email or web form).

closed.description: True once the host considers the matter finished. Providers may use closed records as labelled examples.

extra.description: Host-chosen display fields, rendered as-is. They are not vocabulary and must not carry content the host would not transmit.

metadata.description: Since 1.2.0. Host-defined structured fields for the record (for example the fields of a per-type metadata template). Flat, with scalar values; the provider must not assume a schema for them. A host sends them only when its own policy allows it, and leaves the property out otherwise.
